# The Nexus Club

> The Nexus Club is a gym and fitness studio in Alibag, Maharashtra, India, with a gym floor (Realleader equipment), yoga, zumba and bokwa sessions, and a steam room.

- Address: 1st Floor, Mahavir Plaza, Alibag Rewas Road, Alibag, Maharashtra 402201
- Phone and WhatsApp: +91 98818 80499
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/thenexusclub.alibag/
- Founders: Paresh Bhatheja and Narendra Patil

## Membership prices
- 3 months: ₹7,000 (gym floor access)
- 6 months: ₹12,000 (gym floor access)
- 12 months: ₹18,000 (gym floor access, steam once a month)
- 12 months plus: ₹21,000 (gym floor access, steam once a week)

The Founders Circle offer (first 50 members) is sold out; founding prices are closed.
